hero_title: LUXURY WELLNESS SPAS & CERTIFIED ELECTRICAL ENGINEERING
hero_subtitle: Custom-built sauna and steam rooms, residential and commercial electrical installations, and genuine electrical materials across Lagos and Nigeria.
about_text: At PTECH Electrical Ltd (RC 8550305), we combine precision electrical engineering with luxury wellness craftsmanship. Whether we are designing custom cedar saunas and steam rooms for homes, hotels, and spas, executing complete building wiring, or supplying certified electrical materials, every project is built to international safety and durability standards.

services.title: Custom Sauna Rooms
services.description: Bespoke indoor and outdoor dry saunas fitted with commercial-grade heaters, digital controls, and heat-treated timber.

services.title: Luxury Steam Rooms
services.description: Complete waterproof steam room builds with high-output steam generators, aromatherapy diffusers, and tempered glass enclosures.

services.title: Electrical Installations
services.description: Full building conduit and surface wiring, distribution board setup, earthing systems, and safety inspections by certified engineers.

services.title: Electrical Materials Supply
services.description: Bulk and retail supply of armored and non-armored cables, breakers, sockets, lighting fixtures, and industrial accessories.

services.title: Backup Power & Inverters
services.description: Clean solar inverter installations, automatic changeover switches, and load balancing tailored for homes and offices.

services.title: Maintenance & Repairs
services.description: Sauna heater servicing, steam generator descaling, fault tracing, and electrical system upgrades across Lagos.
